KassaKompas · The right direction for your business

About KassaKompas

The right POS starts with understanding how you work. We combine POS, software and IT experience with personal advice, installation and support, helping you choose a solution for your business and team.

Get to know usDiscover our approach

For hospitality, retail and businesses wanting to organise daily operations clearly.

Experience built since 2000

Technical knowledge with your business in mind.

The experience behind KassaKompas dates back to 2000. Over the years we have built expertise in POS systems, software and IT for shops, bakeries, restaurants, hotels and leisure businesses.

We start with your daily work: how you sell, what your team needs to know, what you want to improve and your plans. These questions guide our advice.

From advice to everyday use

One contact for hardware and software.

We help you select and set up your POS, including equipment, software, configuration and installation, with guidance for users.

  • Understand your needs
    We discuss your sector, workstations, existing equipment and desired applications.
  • Make a suitable choice
    From an affordable starter POS to a fuller professional setup, we assess features, scalability and budget together.
  • Prepare and guide
    We make clear arrangements for setup, installation, maintenance and support.

Advice can be provided on site or by video call, whichever is practical for you.

After installation too

Support to keep you moving.

A POS is a daily working tool, so our support continues after delivery. Ask us about use, settings, maintenance and how hardware and software work together.

24/7 support — online and on site

We offer online and on-site support. We agree how to reach us, the guidance you need and how interventions are organised, so expectations are clear.

As your business changes, we help consider additions and adjustments that fit your operations.

What guides us

A solution that remains practical.

We believe in easy-to-use systems with features suited to your business. Technology should support your team and provide clarity.

Ease of use for your team

Consistent controls, clear information and a practical setup are central. We focus on your team’s daily tasks.

Insights for decisions

Sales reports, customer management and other features can help you monitor your business. We discuss useful data and what the chosen solution supports.

A stable foundation

We focus on how hardware, software and daily processes work together, including maintenance, support and potential growth.

Fit your sector

Hospitality works differently from retail. We consider your service, range, team and how customers order and pay.

Cooking Corner

Joachim Verbrugge

Orders and invoicing

Cooking Corner values the clear handling of orders, quotations and invoices in its catering business.

More about this experience

Joachim describes how manually and automatically entered orders support administration. He stresses clear customer quotations and correct invoices afterwards, without unnecessary complexity.

Multiple stores and stock

Valerie values the smooth launch across several shops and the easy controls.

More about this experience

She wanted an easy-to-use system that could be deployed quickly across locations. In her experience, it clearly improved on earlier manual stock tracking.

’t Oud Scheepken

Walter van de Winkel

Daily operations and support

Walter highlights the day-to-day operation of the POS system and the support he can rely on when he has questions.

More about this experience

After years of use, he had recommended the solution to colleagues. He highlights a correctly functioning registered POS, reachable support when problems arise and software that evolves through updates.

De grossist

Bulent Tariq

Webshop and in-store sales

For De grossist, the connection between webshop, physical stores and stock management is central.

More about this experience

Bulent started with a webshop and considered future physical stores when choosing. He wanted to bring online and offline stock and sales together. His feedback also mentions connections between stores and webshop, marketing features and email newsletters.

Mobile service and kitchen workflow

Christophe describes how an ordering tablet supports dining room, bar and terrace operations.

Juwels Loquet

Glenn Loquet

Stores, webshop and central stock

Glenn emphasises central management and connected stock across stores and webshop.

More about this experience

For a multi-store business selling online, he values effective central management. His experience centres on communication between locations and stock visibility to coordinate stores and webshop.

Timoda

Ease of use for the team

Timoda highlights the ergonomic controls and how easily team members learn to use the system.

The feedback describes staff of different ages quickly learning the controls and saving time. It also highlights potential to do more with the software later, such as connecting a webshop.
